Problem Statement:
You are given a sequence containing N integers. Changing a maximum of one element of the sequence will result in a geometric progression with an integer common ratio. Your task is to print the correct geometric progression. ((Ref. 
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geometric_progression
), N >= 4) 
Input Description:
The first line contains the integer N.
The next line contains N space separated integers, A[0], A[1]...A[n-1]/ 
Output Description:
Print N space separated integers, which are in Geometric Progression 
Sample Input:
4
2 3 8 16 
Sample Output:
2 4 8 16 
Explanation:
Changing 3 to 4 gives a GP with common ratio = 2
